sources.location: sdrf-tools cellline lookup HeLa (local Cellosaurus cache; CVCL_0030)

claims.value: 12 BUB3 IP RAW acquisitions, four conditions with three runs each
claims.evidence: The accession-scoped file list contains 12 BUB3-IPs RAW names. Deposited MaxQuant summary has one search row for each RAW stem and three numbered experiments for each of KO#4, KO#20, Venus and Venus-BUB3.

claims.location: source name; factor value[Bub1 cell state]; factor value[purification bait], rows 1-12
claims.value: parental HeLa Venus control, parental HeLa Venus-Bub3, Bub1 C clone 04 Venus-Bub3, Bub1 C clone 20 Venus-Bub3
claims.evidence: The paper Methods names parental HeLa and two Bub1 C clones transfected with Venus-Bub3 and a parental Venus-only control. Run names and MaxQuant Experiment values distinguish KO#04, KO#20, Venus, and Venus-BUB3. Exact linkage of numeric KO designations to paper clone numbers is not asserted.

claims.location: characteristics[organism], characteristics[cell line], characteristics[cellosaurus accession], rows 1-12
claims.evidence: The publication Methods explicitly identifies parental HeLa and derived Bub1 C clones; the local Cellosaurus lookup maps HeLa to CVCL_0030 and Homo sapiens.

claims.location: characteristics[organism part], characteristics[sampling site], characteristics[age], characteristics[sex], characteristics[disease], rows 1-12
claims.value: not applicable; uterine cervix; 30Y6M; female; Human papillomavirus-related cervical adenocarcinoma
claims.evidence: The bundled curated HeLa Cellosaurus record CVCL_0030 lists cervix as tissue of origin, donor age 30Y6M, female sex, and Human papillomavirus-related cervical adenocarcinoma as the original donor-tissue disease. The paper confirms HeLa and derived clones. Per the cell-line annotation guidance, source anatomy is represented in characteristics[sampling site]; characteristics[organism part] is not applicable to the cultured cell-line material.

claims.value: one biological source per condition; technical replicates 1-3
claims.evidence: Figure EV2 says the Venus-Bub3 mass spectrometry was performed on three technical replicates of Venus purification. Deposited MaxQuant summary encodes four groups with run numbers 1, 2, and 3.

The paper Methods specifies Q Exactive HF-X for AP-MS. The first 256 KiB of representative deposited August and October RAW acquisitions directly encode Q Exactive HF-X. The PRIDE project instrument CV lists the broader Q Exactive model.

claims.location: comment[cleavage agent details], comment[modification parameters], comment[fragment mass tolerance], rows 1-12
claims.value: Trypsin; fixed carbamidomethyl C, variable oxidation M and protein N-terminal acetyl; 20 ppm fragment tolerance
claims.evidence: The paper and PRIDE sample protocol state trypsin digestion. The BUB3 MaxQuant archive summary specifies Trypsin/P, oxidation M and protein N-terminal acetyl; parameters.txt specifies fixed carbamidomethyl C and 20 ppm FTMS MS/MS tolerance.

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[dissociation method], comment[collision energy], rows 1-12
claims.evidence: The paper Methods describes top-15 data-dependent acquisition with HCD at NCE 27.
The published AP-MS preparation and PRIDE sample protocol specify DTT reduction and CAA alkylation.

limitations: The accession also contains 24 BUB1B-IPs RAW files in a separate MaxQuant archive; they are not covered by this BUB3 file and require a separate SDRF.
The BUB1B series includes three bead-only controls, which need spec-consistent blank handling before annotation.
The first 256 KiB of one August and one October RAW file were inspected, rather than all 12 RAW headers. The paper also explicitly names Q Exactive HF-X.
The numeric KO#04 and KO#20 run designations are preserved; they are not mapped to the paper clone 1/2 names without a direct key.

A biological replicate value of 1 denotes the single source group for each condition, while the three acquisitions are documented technical replicates. Donor demographics and disease status are not inferred.

The record reconciler treats the Venus-only experimental control as a healthy control, so it may flag the HeLa donor disease incorrectly. Venus-only controls remain HeLa cells derived from the same cancer donor.
